_doc: Owner-verified local cut deviations, applied by build_cuts.py. See loader docstring.

deviations.reason: Sheet 7's 'Scale of Feet' bar occupies 21st St street space at the cut; default midline clips its label edge. Deviating the cut north gives the whole bar area to sheet 9, which authentically maps that ground as blank street with the continuous 10-inch pipe line - the brief-preferred source-ownership removal of interior furniture. Archival scans untouched.
deviations.verified_by: controller (Fable), from 1:1 sheet-7 crop and solved transforms
deviations._note_frame: t is the street line's along-parameter relative to line_fit.p0 (for 21st: t = mosaic_x - 3184.96); offset along line_fit.normal (+y), so -18 px moves the cut north, clearing the scale bar's top edge (mosaic y -3431) by ~25 px

deviations.reason: D-018 duplicated street label. Sheets 10 (west) and 43 (east) BOTH letter Ave. F or Church here, each with its cross-reference numeral ('43' on sheet 10, '10' on sheet 43), and both label bands straddle the pooled midline cut - sheet 10 at canvas x 19782-19949, sheet 43 at 19860-19933. The composite therefore showed half of each, 180 deg apart, as an illegible tangle. Moving the cut 123 px west (to canvas x ~19770) puts BOTH bands east of it, so sheet 43 supplies one complete label and sheet 10's duplicate is suppressed by ownership, not erased. Clearances: sheet 10's last drawn content ends 19745 (25 px), sheet 43's west page edge ends 19726 (44 px clear of the new cut). The cut stays in blank street on both plates.
deviations.verified_by: controller (Opus), from per-plate warps and ink-cluster extents at 1:1
deviations._note_frame: Ave F normal = (-1,-0.003), so POSITIVE offset moves the cut WEST. t = mosaic_y - 48.0.
